name: LigandMPNN
summary: Protein sequence design conditioned on atomic context such as small molecules, nucleic acids, and metals.

steps: Review the official README and clone a specific maintainer commit into a user-chosen directory.
Create the recommended isolated Python environment, then inspect and install the repository requirements after choosing CPU or GPU PyTorch.
Review get_model_params.sh and the checkpoint destinations before downloading weights; record the selected model and disk use.
install.verify_note: Check that run.py and the selected checkpoint exist, then run a documented example only after the user approves the input and compute cost.

notes: The repository also contains ProteinMPNN inference code. Protein–nucleic-acid design here is sequence design conditioned on nucleic-acid atoms, not docking.
